_doc: Kalshi × Polymarket Arb Bot VE6.3 — Live execution bot. Safe to commit. API credentials live in api-keys.json (gitignored).
_doc_mode: Trading mode. 'paper' = simulate trades, fetch live prices but never place real orders. 'live' = place real orders (requires api-keys.json credentials).
_doc_fallback_to_paper: When false: if mode=live and any credential is missing, bot exits immediately with an error rather than silently running in paper mode. Set to true only during testing.
_doc_min_edge_pct: Minimum edge percentage required to trigger a trade. 0.001 = 0.1% edge after fees.
_doc_max_contracts: Maximum contracts to accumulate in a single arb trade. Depth-walk stops when this cap is reached.
_doc_scan_interval_seconds: Seconds between full scan cycles in 'run' mode.
_doc_pairs_per_cycle: Max pairs to scan per cycle. Pairs with open positions are always scanned first; the rest rotate so every pair gets checked evenly.
_doc_max_workers: Parallel threads for fetching orderbook data. Higher = faster scans, but too high triggers 429 rate-limits from Kalshi. 10 is a safe default.
_doc_print_market_status: Print a one-line market snapshot for every pair each cycle, even when no arb is found.
_doc_play_sounds: Play audio notifications on trade entry and exit.
_doc_skip_multi_outcome: When true, pairs with 3+ Polymarket outcomes are silently skipped each cycle.
_doc_exit_enabled: Monitor open positions and sell at bids when the exit rule is met.
_doc_exit_target_total_price: Combined YES+NO bid threshold to trigger early exit (e.g. 0.99). V6 holds to expiry by default — only used for early-exit scanning.
_doc_pairs_input_mode: 'csv' = load from the newest file in input_files_dir each cycle (hot-reloads). 'excel' = load from pairs_file.
_doc_input_files_dir: Directory where daily CSV pairs files are dropped. Bot auto-uses the newest file.
_doc_pairs_file: Fallback pairs file (Excel or CSV). Used when pairs_input_mode is 'excel' or no CSV is found in input_files_dir.
_doc_user_pairs_dirs: Paths to Polytoken per-user pairs directories. Each is scanned for {username}/pairs.csv at startup and merged into pairs_file.
_doc_position_file: JSON file tracking currently open positions across restarts.
_doc_entry_log: File where entry trades are logged (one JSON object per line).
_doc_exit_log: File where exit trades are logged.
_doc_opportunities_log: File where every detected arb opportunity is logged.
_doc_expired_log: Pairs past their resolution_date are permanently logged here and never fetched again.
_doc_failed_log: Pairs that fail to fetch are logged here and skipped for the session.
_doc_bad_log: Same-side/inverted pairs are permanently logged here.
_doc_fees: Fee formulas (math expressions). Variables: p = price (0–1), c = contracts.

kalshi._doc: Kalshi taker fee. round_up_to_cent=true matches Kalshi's actual billing.

polymarket._doc: rate is applied when feesEnabled=true for a market. formula is for config validation only.

_doc_dropbox: Dropbox upload settings. Credentials (app_key, app_secret, refresh_token) go in api-keys.json.
_doc_export_on_startup: Run a trade export to CSV on bot startup. Output: data/trades_export_YYYY-MM-DD.csv.

proxy._comment: Real host/port/username/password live in api-keys.json under top-level proxy key. Set enabled true there to activate.
